values.note: The 140 water/electric sites in Kanza, Kiowa, Cheyenne and Kaw reserve site-specific on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov); unreserved sites allow self-registration on arrival, and the primitive areas (Osage, Sioux, Pawnee and others) take no reservations. In winter only the Kanza and Cheyenne concrete sites are open, first come first served. 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends. Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park.

note: KDWP park on the north shore of 12,500-acre Waconda Lake (Glen Elder Reservoir). Reservable water/electric sites, mostly 50-amp, in four campgrounds: Kanza (66, the largest, by the marina cove), Kiowa (20, just north of Kanza), Cheyenne (36, 0.8 km east) and Kaw (18, 1 km west), on concrete, asphalt or gravel pads; primitive camping in Kanza and Cheyenne and in several unreserved areas (Osage, Sioux, Pawnee). Shower houses at Kanza, Cheyenne and Kaw; full-service marina; two rental cabins. --Claude
